requirements.statement: The system shall display a public catalog of ceramic products with name, description, photo(s), price, and available stock count.

criteria.must: The catalog lists products showing name, price, and stock/availability
A product's detail page shows its description and photo(s)

requirements.statement: The system shall let shoppers browse the catalog by category and view a single product's detail page.

criteria.must: Shoppers can filter the catalog by category
Selecting a product opens its detail page

requirements.statement: The system shall let shoppers search products by keyword and filter by category and price range.

criteria.must: A keyword search returns products whose name or description matches
A price-range filter narrows catalog results to that range

requirements.statement: The system shall mark a product as sold out and prevent it from being added to a cart once its stock count reaches zero.

criteria.must: A product with zero stock is displayed as sold out
Adding a sold-out product to the cart is prevented

requirements.statement: Each product is a single, simple SKU (no variants), with stock tracked per product, possibly as low as 1.

criteria.must: A product listing has no variant/option selection (single price and stock per product)
A product's stock count can be set to 1 and is tracked at the product level

requirements.statement: The system shall let a shopper add a product to a cart, remove a product, and change the quantity of a cart line, subject to available stock.

criteria.must: A shopper can add a product to the cart
A shopper can remove a product from the cart
A shopper can change a cart line's quantity

requirements.statement: The system shall persist the cart for a guest shopper for the duration of their session/browser, and persist it across sessions for a signed-in shopper.

criteria.must: A guest shopper's cart contents remain intact while browsing within the same browser session
A signed-in shopper's cart contents persist across separate sign-in sessions

requirements.statement: The system shall prevent the cart quantity for a product from exceeding its currently available stock, and shall show a clear message when requested quantity is unavailable.

criteria.must: Requesting a cart quantity greater than available stock is rejected
A clear, actionable message is shown when the requested quantity is unavailable

requirements.statement: The system shall show a running subtotal for the cart's contents.

criteria.must: The cart displays a subtotal that reflects the sum of its line items

requirements.statement: The system shall let a shopper check out either as a guest or, if signed in, using saved profile/address information.

criteria.must: A guest shopper can complete checkout by providing name, email, shipping address, and payment details
A signed-in shopper can check out using a previously saved address without re-entering it

requirements.statement: The system shall collect a shipping address and compute an order total consisting of item subtotal, shipping cost, and applicable tax.

criteria.must: Checkout collects a shipping address before order submission
The displayed order total equals item subtotal plus shipping cost plus tax

requirements.statement: The system shall process payment for the order total through a real payment gateway before the order is confirmed.

criteria.must: Checkout submits payment through the payment gateway before the order is confirmed

requirements.statement: The system shall re-validate stock availability for every cart line at checkout time and reject/adjust the order if an item has sold out since it was added to the cart.

criteria.must: Checkout re-checks stock for every cart line at submission time
An item that sold out after being added to the cart causes checkout to reject or adjust that line rather than silently succeeding

requirements.statement: On successful payment, the system shall decrement stock for each purchased product, create an order record, and show/send an order confirmation including an order number.

criteria.must: A successful payment decrements stock for each purchased product by the purchased quantity
A successful payment creates an order record
The shopper is shown or sent an order confirmation that includes an order number

requirements.statement: If payment fails or is declined, the system shall leave the cart intact, not decrement stock, and show the shopper an actionable error message.

criteria.must: A declined payment leaves the shopper's cart contents intact
A declined payment does not decrement product stock
A declined payment shows the shopper an actionable error message allowing retry

requirements.statement: The system shall not store raw payment card data itself; card data handling shall be delegated to the payment gateway.

criteria.must: No raw card number, CVV, or magnetic-stripe/track data is persisted by the system's own data store

requirements.statement: The system shall let a visitor register for an account and sign in/out; guest checkout shall remain fully available without registering.

criteria.must: A visitor can register a new account with email and password
A registered shopper can sign in and sign out
A shopper can complete checkout without registering or signing in

requirements.statement: A signed-in shopper shall be able to view a list of their past orders and the detail/status of each order.

criteria.must: A signed-in shopper can view a list of their own past orders
A signed-in shopper can view the detail and status of an individual past order

requirements.statement: A signed-in shopper shall be able to save and reuse a shipping address on future orders.

criteria.must: A signed-in shopper can save a shipping address to their account
A saved shipping address can be reused on a subsequent order

requirements.statement: The system shall let a store admin sign in to a separate admin interface, distinct from the shopper-facing site.

criteria.must: The store admin signs in through an admin interface separate from the shopper-facing storefront

requirements.statement: The system shall let a store admin create, edit, publish/unpublish, and delete catalog products, including name, description, price, category, photos, and stock count.

criteria.must: A store admin can create a new product with name, description, price, category, photos, and stock count
A store admin can edit an existing product's fields
A store admin can publish or unpublish a product
A store admin can delete a product

requirements.statement: The system shall let a store admin adjust a product's stock count directly.

criteria.must: A store admin can directly set/adjust a product's stock count

requirements.statement: The system shall let a store admin view all orders, view an individual order's contents/customer/shipping details, and update its fulfillment status.

criteria.must: A store admin can view a list of all orders
A store admin can view an individual order's contents, customer, and shipping details
A store admin can update an order's fulfillment status

requirements.statement: The system shall let a store admin view basic sales/order-volume information.

criteria.must: A store admin can view order volume and/or revenue information over a period

requirements.statement: Admin functionality shall be accessible only to authenticated users holding the store-admin role; shopper accounts shall not have access to admin functions.

criteria.must: An unauthenticated user cannot access admin product/order management functions
A signed-in shopper without the store-admin role cannot access admin functions

requirements.statement: Stock decrements shall be atomic with order creation so concurrent checkouts cannot oversell a product, especially for one-of-a-kind pieces with stock count 1.

criteria.must: Two concurrent checkout attempts on the last unit of a product result in exactly one successful, paid order
The unsuccessful concurrent purchaser sees a sold-out message and is not charged

requirements.statement: Every order shall retain an immutable record of what was purchased, at what price, and its shipping address, even if the underlying product listing is later edited or removed.

criteria.must: An order's recorded line-item price and shipping address remain unchanged after the underlying product is later edited or deleted
